scientific: One fixed 35-vertex odd graph, rather than a uniform theorem for all Kneser graphs.
The individual exponential-bandwidth classification for powers above the negative-type threshold is proved only at exponent one.
The exact Kneser/Johnson spectrum and distance formula are existing methods; the claimed contribution is the new exact powered-distance and heat-threshold classification.
Literature searches and primary-source inspection are bounded; unindexed equivalent treatments cannot be excluded.

title: Sharp negative type and an exact distance-exponential cutoff on the odd graph \(O_4\)
